headline: As of 2026-10-06: 1,562,404 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 32 of 50 states, D+32.3 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 1,562,404 early/mail ballots cast so far across 32 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+32.3 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (387,232), Florida (226,956), Michigan (201,909).
